remarks: Welcome home to this inviting 3-bedroom, 1.5 bath home offering an updated interior, comfortable living spaces and a convenient location close to shopping, dining and everyday amenities. The first floor features an open, easy-flow layout with hardwood floors, recessed lighting and a cozy brick fireplace anchoring the spacious living area. The beautifully updated kitchen is a standout featuring white cabinetry, granite countertop, stainless steel appliances, tile backsplash and a large center island with plenty of workspace and room for seating. A convenient half bath completes the first floor. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms, including a generously sized primary bedroom with excellent closet space. The updated full bath offers a double vanity, soaking tub and separate glass-enclosed shower with stylish tile work. Outside, a large rear deck provides plenty of room for relaxing, grilling or entertaining, while the attached 2-car garage adds everyday convenience and additional storage. A great opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers or anyone looking for a move-in-ready home with many of today's most-wanted updates!
